chunks: I advise you, O creatures of Allah,
for it is the rein and the mainstay. Hold fast to its salient points, keep hold of its realities. It will take you to abodes of ease, places of comfort, fortresses of safety, and houses of honor.
(On the) Day when eyes will be wide open,

when there will be darkness all around, when small groups of camels pregnant for ten months will be allowed free grazing, and when the Horn will be blown, then every living being will die, every voice will become dumb, the high mountains and hard rocks will crumble,
so that their hard stones will turn into moving sand and their bases will become level.
(On that day) there will be no interceder to intercede and no relation to ward off (trouble), and no excuse will be of avail.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs and events of the Day of Judgment according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) exhorts the believers to hold fast to God-consciousness (taqwa), describing it as the means to reach safety and honor on the Day of Judgment. He vividly describes the events of that Day, including the blowing of the Horn, the death of all souls, the crumbling of mountains, and the cessation of intercession and excuses. This passage reflects the Shia emphasis on *taqwa* as the ultimate spiritual armor, drawing on Quranic imagery of cosmic upheaval to underscore the finality of divine judgment where worldly power yields to spiritual reality.

en.sayed-ali-raza: I advise you, O creatures of Allāh,

to have fear of Allāh, for it is the rein and the mainstay (of religion). Hold fast to its salient points, keep hold of its realities. It will take you to abodes of easiness, places of comfort, fortresses of safety and houses of honour

when eyes will be wide open, (Qur’ān, 14:42), when there will be darkness all round, when small groups of camels pregnant for ten months will be allowed free grazing, and when the Horn will be blown, then every living being will die, every voice will become dumb the high mountains and hard rocks will crumble (to pieces)
so that their hard stones will turn into moving sand and their bases will become level.
(On that day) there will be no interceder to intercede and no relation to ward off (trouble), and no excuse will be of avail.
